title: Add support for joypad haptic effects (force feedback)

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8309

This PR exposes [SDL's Haptic subsystem](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/CategoryHaptic) to the user.
(P.S. Personally, I don't know how to use this subsystem, but other people do, so it would be useful to them 😅)

The documentation was made with help from [DirectInput force feedback documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/desktop/ee417563(v=vs.85)) and [SDL Haptic subsystem documentation](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/CategoryHaptic).

*Made possible by my small [GodotBoilerplateGenerator](https://github.com/Nintorch/GodotBoilerplateGenerator) :D*

TODO:
- ~~What is an `offset` parameter mentioned in the original proposal exactly?~~
- ~~Is this approach good enough or should we expose the entirety of the haptic subsystem? (With `InputHapticEffect` classes, constants and such, which sounds quite tedious to both use and implement 😅)~~
- ~~Other effect types?~~
- [x] Finish class boilerplate
- [x] Replace `M_PI` with `Math::PI`

- [ ] Trigger button
